@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary unit symbol, kept Latin in Hungarian: Xfce Thunar hu writes KiB (thunar.po, 512 KiB / 1 MiB / 1 GiB), KDE Dolphin hu keeps MiB, and Microsoft Terminology hu lists MiB/GiB unchanged.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI kilobyte symbol with lowercase k, as Hungarian writes it: GNOME Nautilus hu (4 kB / 4 MB) and Total Commander hu (kB/mp, kB-ban).

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: International unit symbol; Hungarian macOS Finder writes MB (LocalizableMerged SP25).
